sn32.57:1.3: Ko nu kho bhante hetu ko paccayo yenekadā devo vassatīti || || 4
sn32.57:1.6: Yaṃ nuna mayaṃ sakāya ratiyā rameyyāmāti || tesantaṃ cetopaṇidhim anvāya devo vassati || || 5
sn32.57:1.7: Ayaṃ kho bhikkhu hetu ayam paccayo yenekadā devo vassatīti || ||
sn32.57:1.8: Valāha- saṃyuttaṃ || || Vitthārena sattapaññāsa suttantā bhavanti || ||
